Correction checkpoint after the independent review failure. Exact unpushed commit 6bba0ae6a6de8253d62ecdd6250cd72ba8d7acad supersedes b3c7a95fd0d53772488c7dd0504c52961b2249d7 on unchanged parent e61b6bdae7423c9e8cd885dc50a20ce685f79280. The amendment changes only allowlisted comments prose. It replaces all 12 newly introduced banned `real`, `actual`, and `genuine` usages with mechanism-specific wording, removes all 16 newly introduced semicolons, replaces the one clause-joining colon, and names the network socket directly.

All six documentation-session verification commands pass at the amended SHA. The immutable-prose-only oracle confirms exactly 59 strictly shorter targets across exactly 18 paths with immutable parent targets, protected prose, directive and shebang attachment, normalized executable AST, and zero-context hunk scope exact. Exact-leaf-paths, scoped Ruff check and format, comment hygiene, and diff integrity pass. Focused pytest passes with 292 tests in 4 minutes 40 seconds. The commit hook passes repository lint and typecheck. `verify-commit-ticket --rev HEAD` resolves 9793-7ffa-d751-41a1, and the Change-Id, DCO sign-off, and full ticket trailer remain intact. A scan of all added lines finds zero banned authenticity terms, semicolons, em dashes, or en dashes. Full `make verify` remains intentionally omitted under the documentation-only session instruction, with CI supplying repository-wide verification. No Gerrit push has occurred. Fresh non-author exact-SHA documentation review is required.
